title: A miracle; the raising of the dead
summary: Mosè Bianchi's etching of a body called back from death, lettered only "Un miracle." Printed in Milan in 1894 and published by Cadart in Paris.
body: Bianchi was a Lombard painter of the Scapigliatura circle, and the print leans on the melodrama of that movement — the crowd pressing in, the light falling on the corpse rather than the miracle-worker.
medium: Etching with drypoint, image 27.3 × 37 cm. Milan, 1894.
image_alt: Etching of a crowd around a raised body
